_note: What Carla says in the Hardening shop (Shop/Dialogue). She says a greeting when the shop opens, a line when the player clicks a card or an upgrade, and a line after a purchase. Keep a line short (the box is narrow): about 90 letters at most. The upgrade lines say in everyday words what the upgrade is for.
greeting: Welcome! Have a look around, and spend your points wisely.
Hi! Pick what fits the problem you found, not what looks coolest.
Back again? Remember: the fix should match the problem.
bought_card: Good pick! Put it in your deck with EDIT DECK.
Done. Add it to your deck when you are ready.
bought_upgrade: Good choice! Now equip it under EDIT UPGRADES, or it will not help you.
Remember: an upgrade only works once it is equipped.

upgrades.unique: One key for every door is risky. Give each account its own password.
upgrades.twostep: A stolen password is not enough if the thief also needs your phone.
upgrades.lockout: After a few wrong tries, lock the account. Guessing gets them nowhere.
upgrades.alerts: A strange sign-in at 03:00? This tells you at once, while there is still time.
upgrades.allowlist: Only approved programs may run. A trojan cannot pretend to be a gift.
upgrades.updates: Updates close the holes a worm crawls through. Keep everything up to date.
upgrades.antivirus: A watcher that never sleeps. Spyware has nowhere to hide.
upgrades.attachments: Scan the file before anyone opens it. It gives you time to react.
upgrades.filter: Catch the fake parcel notice before anyone clicks. It warns you earlier, and you hit a little harder.
upgrades.folders: Put walls between the folders. A lock cannot cross a wall.
upgrades.offline: A backup kept apart from the network. The attacker has nothing to ask a price for.
upgrades.encrypt: A stolen copy that cannot be read is worth nothing. Double extortion falls apart.
upgrades.least: Each person gets only the access the job needs. Where the attacker can appear shrinks.
upgrades.activity: A bell that rings when something odd keeps going. The slow copy stops half way.
upgrades.outgoing: Watch what leaves the building. The carriers slow down, and you see which file they want.
upgrades.exit: Close a person's access the day they leave. You get a longer warning before every attack.
upgrades.egress: Data may go only to approved places. The leak closes, and you hit a little harder.
upgrades.flagodd: A flag on odd transfers. The big grab comes apart, and you start each turn with Block.
upgrades.ports: Close the doors nobody uses. Lanes light up before they fire, and you can take more.
upgrades.labels: Label what is private. Every attack waits a little longer, and you start with more Energy.
upgrades.spread: Share the load between servers. You heal a little every turn, and the flood comes from one side at a time.
upgrades.limit: Cap what one visitor may ask for. You start every turn with a Dodge, and each source may fire only twice.
upgrades.idle: Close connections that sit open. You hit a little harder, and a held connection closes after a moment.
upgrades.spare: Keep spare capacity for sudden rises. You can take more, and every attack waits a little longer.
upgrades.sender: Read the sender letter by letter. Fake envelopes carry a warning mark, and you start every turn with Block.
upgrades.training: Teach the staff what a fake looks like. The fake page shows what it is, and you heal a little every turn.
upgrades.key: A key you hold, not a password you type. A stolen password does a third of the damage, and you can take more.
upgrades.reporter: One button to report a fake. Every attack waits a little longer, and you start with more Energy.
upgrades.input: Check what comes in. A piece you touch is cleaned so it cannot join another, and you start every turn with Block.
upgrades.framework: Install the maker's fix. A hole that split again and again splits only once, and you can take more.
upgrades.adminlock: Lock the master door. A stolen admin key does a third of the damage, and you heal a little every turn.
upgrades.waf: A wall in front of the site. Every attack waits a little longer, and you start with two more cards.

cards.probe: A quick poke to see what is out there. Cheap, and it adds up.
cards.patch: Fix a weak spot before someone uses it. You even draw a card.
cards.audit: Check everything on the list. You will spot more and draw 3 cards.
cards.hunt: Go looking for the intruder instead of waiting. Hits hard, draws a card.
cards.encrypt: Scrambled data is useless to a thief. A good block, and a card.
cards.shutdown: Cut the attacker off completely. A big hit, and a little block.
cards.fast_scan: A quick scan that costs nothing. A small hit, and it draws a card.
cards.quarantine: Lock the bad program away. It hits, and you heal a little.
cards.sandbox: Let it run where it cannot hurt anything. A good hit, and a little healing.
cards.disinfect: Clean it out for good. The biggest hit of the week, and it heals you.
cards.av_shield: The antivirus on watch: a little block, a little healing.
cards.rollback: Go back to when everything worked. Strong block, and some HP back.
cards.safe_mode: Start with only the basics. Block now, and a spare Energy.
cards.reboot: Turn it off and on again. It really does help: heal 4.
cards.backup: A spare copy saves the day. Heal and draw a card.
cards.update: Updates give you more to work with. A spare Energy and two cards.
cards.cut_cable: Cut the cable and the attacker loses their grip. A small hit, and you slip away.
cards.decrypt: A key that opens the lock again. It costs two energy and hits hard.
cards.wipe: Wipe it clean and start over. Expensive, but it hits hardest, and you dodge one.
cards.lockpick: A cheap, steady hit. Good when you need a little more damage.
cards.air_gap: A gap of empty space, no cable at all. A bit of Block, and one hit that cannot land.
cards.offline_copy: The copy you keep apart cannot be touched. Two hits will pass right through.
cards.snapshot: A picture of the files, taken before the trouble. Solid Block for one energy.
cards.backup_check: Test the backup. A little healing, and you draw a card.
cards.rotate_keys: Change the keys. It costs nothing, and the next hit does no damage.
cards.redundancy: Three copies are safer than one. Two Dodge, and a card.
cards.access_audit: Check who opened what. It costs one energy, and the threat takes more damage from every card after it.
cards.cross_check: Compare two lists and see what does not match. A little damage, and a card.
cards.deep_review: A close look at everything. Solid damage, and the threat is exposed for the rest of your turn.
cards.revoke: Take the access away. It is expensive, it hits hard, and it heals a little.
cards.need_to_know: Only the people who need it get in. A bit of Block, and you draw a card.
cards.access_check: A turnstile that only opens for the right badge. Plenty of Block, and a little healing.
cards.two_person_rule: Two keys for one lock. Block, and the next hit does nothing.
cards.flag_account: Flag the account. It costs nothing, and every card you play after it hits harder.
cards.ask_hr: Ask before you decide. You draw two cards and heal a little.
cards.review_log: Read the log with care. A little healing, and the threat is exposed twice over.
cards.sniffer: Listen to the traffic. A little damage, and you draw a card.
cards.egress_cut: Cut a way out. It hits hard, and you get Energy next turn.
cards.trace_route: Follow the path back. A little damage, and a little healing.
cards.data_seizure: Take the data back. One big hit, and nothing else.
cards.closed_port: A port with a plug. Block now, and Energy next turn.
cards.sealed_pipe: A pipe with a cap. A lot of Block, and a little healing.
cards.rate_limit: A gate with a counter. Some Block, and you draw a card.
cards.recharge: Pay now for next turn: one Energy later.
cards.night_job: A job at night. Two Energy next turn, and a card now.
cards.audit_log: Read the log. It is free: a card, and a little healing.
cards.ping: A quick ping, then step aside. A little damage and a Dodge.
cards.packet_trap: Trap the packets in a net. Solid damage, and the threat is exposed.
cards.blackhole: Swallow the flood. Some damage, and the hits of this enemy turn are capped.
cards.takedown: Take down the botnet node. One big hit, and nothing else.
cards.rate_cap: A rate cap. A little Block now, and no hit hurts more than 4.
cards.load_balancer: Split the stream across servers. Block, and a Dodge on top.
cards.choke_point: A narrow door. A lot of Block, and no hit hurts more than 5.
cards.throttle: Turn the tap half closed. Cap the hits, and draw a card.
cards.warm_cache: Keep the answers ready. It is free: a card and a little Block.
cards.failover: Swap to the spare server. You heal a little and draw two cards.
cards.spam_trap: Catch the junk before it spreads. A little damage, and you draw a card.
cards.honeypot: Sweet bait with a spark inside. Some damage, and every hit on you is sent back.
cards.blocklist: Put the sender on the list. Solid damage, and the threat is exposed.
cards.sinkhole: Pull the whole flood into a hole. One big hit, and nothing else.
cards.verify: Check first. A little Block, and each hit that lands is sent back.
cards.hover_check: Hover over the link before you click. Some Block, and you draw a card.
cards.mail_filter: A sieve for the inbox. A lot of Block, and every hit is sent back twice.
cards.mirror: Hold up a mirror. Hits on you are sent back harder, and you draw a card.
cards.spot_check: A quick look at the letter. It is free: a card and a little Block.
cards.report_it: Report it, and the staff are safer. You heal a little and draw a card.
cards.fuzz_test: Throw random text at the box. A little damage, and a lot more if it is already exposed.
cards.pen_test: Try the lock like an attacker would. Solid damage, and a big bonus against an exposed threat.
cards.hotfix: Patch it fast. Some damage, with a bonus when the threat is exposed.
cards.lockdown: Slam the door. The biggest hit of the set, and bigger still against an exposed threat.
cards.input_filter: Catch the quote before it gets in. A little Block, and the threat is exposed.
cards.safe_query: Ask the database the safe way. A lot of Block, and you heal a little.
cards.web_shield: A shield in front of the page. A little Block, and one hit cancelled.
cards.read_logs: Read what really happened. It is free: a card, and the threat is exposed.
cards.code_review: Two pairs of eyes on the code. The threat is exposed twice over, and you draw a card.
cards.fresh_backup: A new copy, just in case. You heal and draw a card.
